scripts.sync:widget: pnpm --filter @open333crm/shared build && pnpm --filter @open333crm/widget build && mkdir -p public/webchat && cp ../widget/dist/widget.js public/webchat/widget.js
scripts.sync:playcaptcha: rm -rf public/toys public/playcaptcha.svg && mkdir -p public/toys && cp -R node_modules/playcaptcha/assets/toys/. public/toys/ && cp node_modules/playcaptcha/assets/playcaptcha.svg public/playcaptcha.svg
scripts.dev: pnpm sync:widget && pnpm sync:playcaptcha && next dev --port 3000
scripts.build: pnpm sync:widget && pnpm sync:playcaptcha && next build
